description: msg_id is a lowercase hyphenated UUIDv7 (RFC 9562), monotonic per sender. Receivers and the Hub order msg_ids by plain string comparison, which equals byte order for valid ids. Reference layout (RFC 9562 §6.2 method 1): unix_ts_ms (48 bits) | ver 0111 | 12-bit counter in rand_a | var 10 | 62 random bits (the low 62 bits of rand_b_hex). The counter is reseeded with a random 11-bit value (top bit clear) on each new millisecond and incremented otherwise; if the clock goes backwards the last timestamp is reused; on counter overflow the timestamp is advanced by 1 ms. Other implementations may use any RFC 9562 method 1 or 3 generator; only `format`, `valid`/`invalid` and the monotonic property are normative. `generator_sequence` documents this generator with rng = the test-vector seeded stream "uuid/generator" (10 bytes per id: 2 counter-seed bytes, 8 rand_b bytes; stream block i = SHA-256("carom/v1/test-vectors/uuid/generator/" || u32be(i))).
